claims.claim_text: Architected a governed, policy-gated agent execution surface for enterprise AI workflows, establishing L0 route-policy dispatch, runtime gate verdict contracts, and proof-bundle lineage for reproducible, auditable agent traces.

Drove CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization, pairing partner-facing deal support with usage-based subscription forecasting to expand enterprise workflow adoption.
Delivered audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows by combining runtime resilience controls and context engineering with disciplined evaluation-gate governance.
Accelerated the AI systems lifecycle from six months to three weeks through managed workflow orchestration and replayable runtime design across intake, validation, and production monitoring stages.

Established cloud data and runtime integration patterns across Databricks Lakehouse, vector services, and API gateways, applying dense sparse exact retrieval design and provider egress governance for high-availability distributed execution.

Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while advancing agentic platform productization and an operating model for agentic AI that converted delivery work into reusable, commercialized platform capability.
